info.name: KHR_LIGHT_QUAD
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension, trimmed to what this device implements. 'side' supports all three registry values; with 'both' each face emits the resolved radiance, so 'intensity'/'power' are interpreted per face (total flux doubles). 'intensityDistribution' is declared with FLOAT32 elements per the spec text (the registry JSON says FLOAT32_VEC3, but the spec table and the CTS use scalars); values modulate the resolved radiance: 1D is rotationally symmetric over the polar angle from the emitting face's normal (uniform on [0,pi], >=2 entries), 2D rows are C-halfplanes uniform over [0,2pi) anchored at edge1, increasing right-handed around the emission direction (IES LM-63 Type C winding); for side='back'/'both' each face gets the profile mirrored about the quad's plane. LIMITATION: 'intensity'/'power' are converted to radiance using the light's LOCAL edge area at commit time, so they are only exact for unscaled instances; 'radiance' is exact under any instance transform. The distribution's angular mapping is exact under rigid/uniform-scale instance transforms; non-uniform instance scaling skews the lookup angles slightly. Keep info.name equal to the official extension name so introspection still advertises it.

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: overall amount of light emitted in a direction in W/sr (converted using the local edge area; exact only for unscaled instances)

parameters.name: power
parameters.description: overall amount of light energy emitted in W (converted using the local edge area; exact only for unscaled instances)

parameters.name: radiance
parameters.description: the amount of light emitted by a point on the light source in a direction in W/sr/m^2

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: light emitting sides of the quad

parameters.name: intensityDistribution
parameters.description: luminous intensity distribution for photometric lights
